<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$err = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/PREVIEW_ERROR.txt';
@unlink($err);
try {

// Pretty permalinks so /shop/ and /checkout/ resolve.
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/');

// Make sure WooCommerce pages and tables exist.
if ( class_exists('WC_Install') ) {
  WC_Install::install();
  if ( method_exists('WC_Install','create_pages') ) { WC_Install::create_pages(); }
}

// Skip the onboarding wizard so the store is immediately usable.
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('completed'=>true,'skipped'=>true));
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_hidden','yes');
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_complete','yes');
delete_transient('_wc_activation_redirect');

// Store basics.
update_option('woocommerce_currency','LKR');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country','LK:LK-1');
update_option('woocommerce_store_address','1 Test Street');
update_option('woocommerce_store_city','Colombo');
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes','no');
update_option('woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout','yes');

// Enable CeyPay in test mode: this uses the sandbox merchant ID and sandbox
// API, and exposes the "Simulate Success" button in the modal. Test mode is
// admin-only by design (see is_available()), and this preview is auto-logged
// in as admin.
update_option('woocommerce_ceypay_settings', array(
  'enabled'       => 'yes',
  'testmode'      => 'yes',
  'merchant_id'   => '',
  'show_branding' => 'yes'
));

// A product to buy. (get_page_by_title() is deprecated/removed on current
// WordPress, so query posts directly.)
$existing = get_posts(array('post_type'=>'product','title'=>'CeyPay Test Product','post_status'=>'any','numberposts'=>1));
if ( empty($existing) ) {
  $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
  $p->set_name('CeyPay Test Product');
  $p->set_regular_price('2500');
  $p->set_description('A sample product for exercising the CeyPay checkout modal.');
  $p->set_short_description('Sample product for the CeyPay preview.');
  $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
  $p->set_stock_status('instock');
  $p->set_virtual(true);
  $p->save();
}

flush_rewrite_rules();

} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {
  file_put_contents($err, get_class($e) . ': ' . $e->getMessage() . ' @ ' . $e->getFile() . ':' . $e->getLine() . "\n");
  throw $e;
}
